content: Iudaia legize aukaise obautmerer nalu Lamarira kelar obakelare waiakai oditomeretlare Kerisora kelar. Giris legize aukaise odasmerlare pardarem.
Kipe no iabim wairemlare Kerisora eud tumem satauroge. Able Iudaia legise dikepwareda able lugide detomerteda Keriso gebgeb dali, a Giris legize dikepwareda e paim lu dikeredi.
Ege Agudide no wader Iudaia le a Giris le darabgerda ko abi wairmirlare, epe able le umele uridli ki wairemlare able Keriso e Agudira sasrim dali a Agudira pardar dali.
Nalu mi dasmereda mokakalam Agud nole kelarkak epe au kelarkelar ikeredi le kelarem, a nalu mi dasmereda mokakalam Agud nole pardarkak epe au pardarpardar ikeredi le pardarem.
